about_description: LeapMultix is a free interactive educational app to practice mental math: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and times tables. Designed for all ages, it offers 5 different game modes: Discovery, Quiz, Challenge, Adventure and Arcade with 4 educational mini-games. The app is fully multilingual and the project is open source.

mnemonic_1: Multiplying by 1: the result equals the number.
mnemonic_3: Multiplying by 3: double the number, then add it again.
mnemonic_4: Multiplying by 4: double the number twice.
mnemonic_5: Multiplying by 5: results end with 0 or 5.
mnemonic_6: Multiplying by 6: five times the number, plus the number.
mnemonic_7: Multiplying by 7: think of the calendar! One week = 7 days, two weeks = 14 days…
mnemonic_9: Multiplying by 9: the digits of the answer always add up to 9 (for example 9 × 5 = 45, and 4 + 5 = 9).

faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about LeapMultix
faq_q1: What age is LeapMultix intended for?
faq_a1: LeapMultix is primarily aimed at children aged 6 to 12 (grades 1-6), but is suitable for anyone who wants to learn or revise multiplication tables. The 5 game modes offer different difficulty levels adapted to each age.
faq_a2: Yes, LeapMultix is 100% free and open source (AGPL-3.0 license). There are no ads, in-app purchases, or subscriptions. All game modes and arcade mini-games are accessible without restrictions.
faq_a3: Yes! LeapMultix is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Once installed on your device, the application works entirely offline. Your progress is saved locally in your browser.
faq_a4: LeapMultix offers 5 game modes: Discovery (learning), Quiz (training), Challenge (against the clock), Adventure (level progression) and Arcade (4 mini-games: Multimiam, Multisnake, Space Invasion, Memory). All of them work with the 4 operations (×, +, −, ÷).
faq_q5: Does it work on mobile and tablet?
faq_a5: Absolutely! LeapMultix is optimized for all screens: smartphone, tablet, computer. The interface adapts automatically (responsive design) and you can install the application like a real native app on iOS and Android.
faq_a6: Yes, your data remains 100% on your device. LeapMultix does not collect any personal data and does not send anything to third-party servers. Your progress is stored locally in the browser (localStorage).
faq_a7: Yes! LeapMultix is available in 3 languages: French, English and Spanish. You can change the language at any time via the menu at the top of the screen.
